articles.title: Leaf Health Enhances Prescription Cost Transparency by Integrating PriceMDs API into LeafIQ
articles.summary: Leaf Health has incorporated the PriceMDs API into its LeafIQ platform to provide users with enhanced visibility into prescription drug pricing options. This integration matters because it equips self-funded employers and benefit managers with better tools to navigate drug costs and steer members toward more affordable options. For the broader industry, this development highlights the ongoing push toward price transparency technologies that help curb specialty and traditional healthcare expenditures.
